description: The outbox reconcile: the document-start script both clients install so a message the Control UI queued is never left stuck on a live connection. This file is the ONE owner of the script; core/outbox-reconcile.js reads it, core/test/outbox-reconcile.test.js drives it against a fake window, socket and storage, the desktop evaluates it from its preload (desktop/src/preload.cjs over the outbox:reconcile-script channel), and the iOS client bundles THIS FILE and installs the script through a WKUserScript (mobile/Chela/OutboxReconcile.swift).
why: The fault it stands in for is upstream. The Control UI's outbox codec (ui/src/lib/chat/outbox-store-codec.ts in the OpenClaw checkout) rewrites every stored in-flight row, `sending` to `waiting-reconnect` and `submitting` to `waiting-idle`, on EVERY write and read of the outbox, not only on the replay after a reload. The queue projection re-reads the store after the next draft or send, so a message the gateway already accepted is shown as "Reconnected before delivery was confirmed" while the socket never dropped, and the rows behind it can wait on a reconnect that never comes. Measured 2026-09-25 on this desktop and on a plain browser against the stock Control UI, with every WebSocket frame logged.

A second, rarer route to the same stuck queue: under load the gateway refused a steered chat.send after 207 seconds with `session changed before chat.send; retry the request`, coded INVALID_REQUEST and not marked retryable, so the page parked the message as failed and it never reached the transcript. The page shows Retry on it; nothing retries it.

What this script does, and only this. Once a second, while the page's own socket is open and has said hello-ok, it reads the page's outbox from sessionStorage. A row that has sat in waiting-reconnect or unconfirmed for 4 seconds, in waiting-idle for 20 seconds, or in failed with a retry-the-request error for 4 seconds, is checked against the gateway's own record with a chat.history request for that row's send id. If the gateway holds it, in the transcript (idempotencyKey `<sendRunId>:user`) or as a pending input that is not cancelled, the row is removed from the outbox: it is delivered, and the page already draws the gateway's copy. If the gateway does not hold it and no run is active, it is sent ONCE with chat.send, under the row's own send id as the idempotency key, so the gateway's dedupe makes a late original and this resend the same message; the send id is recorded in sessionStorage before the request goes out, so a reload or a second pass never sends it again. A row with attachments, a command or an intent is left for the reader.

Why a socket of its own is not opened. The requests go over the page's own socket, after the page's own handshake, so they carry exactly the authority the page already has and add no credential to this app. Their ids are prefixed `chela-outbox-reconcile-`, and the response frames the page does not recognise are ignored by it.

Why it is safe beside the page's own drain. Every action is decided from the gateway's record at that moment, one row at a time in queue order, and the only send it makes is idempotent on the row's own id. A row the page settles first simply disappears from the store before this script reaches it. A closed socket clears every timer, so a real disconnect is left to the page's own reconnect path.

Why document start. The script wraps the WebSocket constructor to see the page's socket, which has to happen before the page opens it. It takes the constructor as it stands at install time and returns the native instance, so the pairing observer and the reconnect-resume shim compose with it in either order, and it never throws into the page.

THE REMOVAL TRIGGER: delete this script once the Control UI this app loads keeps an in-flight row in flight on a live page (the upstream fix to outbox-store-codec.ts) AND the gateway marks the session-changed chat.send refusal retryable. At that point no row reaches the states this script watches without a real disconnect, and the page's own recovery owns it. Its removal is a file deletion plus every pointer: core/spec/outbox-reconcile.json, core/outbox-reconcile.js and its test, the export in core/package.json, the BUNDLED entry in core/test/specs.test.js, the outbox:reconcile-script channel in desktop/src/main.js and desktop/src/preload.cjs with its test, the resource entry in mobile/project.yml, mobile/Chela/OutboxReconcile.swift, its WKUserScript registration in mobile/Chela/WebView.swift, and its parity test.
hook: // Chela outbox reconcile. Installed at document start; see core/spec/outbox-reconcile.json.
var state = { socket: null, ready: false, closedAt: 0, seq: 0, pending: {}, firstSeen: {}, busy: false, log: [] };
for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) { var done = state.pending[ids[i]]; delete state.pending[ids[i]]; done(null); }
if (frame.ok && frame.payload && frame.payload.type === 'hello-ok' && state.socket === ws) { state.ready = true; state.firstSeen = {}; return; }
var done = typeof frame.id === 'string' ? state.pending[frame.id] : null;
var ws = arguments.length > 1 ? new Native(url, protocols) : new Native(url);
try { track(ws); } catch (e) { /* the page's socket must never fail because of this */ }
var timer = setTimeout(function () { if (state.pending[id]) { delete state.pending[id]; resolve(null); } }, REQUEST_MS);
try { ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'req', id: id, method: method, params: params })); } catch (e) { delete state.pending[id]; clearTimeout(timer); resolve(null); }
try { return JSON.parse(storage.getItem(key) || 'null'); } catch (e) { return null; }
if (item && item.id && item.sendRunId && sessionKey && sessionKey.indexOf('global') !== 0) out.push({ key: key, entryKey: entryKey, sessionKey: sessionKey, item: item });
var queue = entry.queue.filter(function (item) { return !(item && item.id === found.item.id); });
if (queue.length) entry.queue = queue; else delete entry.queue;
window.dispatchEvent(new StorageEvent('storage', { key: found.key, oldValue: raw, newValue: next, storageArea: sessionStorage, url: String(window.location && window.location.href) }));
} catch (e) { /* the page re-reads the store on its next write */ }
if (key === runId || key === runId + ':user') return true;
if (pending[j] && pending[j].runId === runId && pending[j].state !== 'cancelled') return true;
return request('chat.history', { sessionKey: found.sessionKey, limit: 200, inputRunIds: [runId] }).then(function (res) {
if (item.attachments || item.attachmentPayload || item.localCommandName || item.intent) { note('left for the reader ' + runId); return; }
var params = { sessionKey: found.sessionKey, message: String(item.text || ''), deliver: false, idempotencyKey: runId };
else note('resend refused ' + runId + ' ' + String(sent && sent.error && sent.error.message));
if (!due && now - state.firstSeen[id] >= limit) due = items[i];
Promise.resolve().then(function () { return reconcile(due); }).catch(function (e) { note('reconcile failed ' + String(e && e.message)); }).then(function () { state.busy = false; });
